answer: The vault assignment is published and velvet records each panel. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the glacier graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1277 impostors cost 1457 times the honest price and take 9 times as long to clear.
